comments.body: Status 2026-11-14: #2119 (sync dependency-audit/CI repair) merges with the red macOS `codex-sandboxing`/`codex-exec-server` crate checks documented as pre-existing (this issue and #2051), per the coordinator's grant; #2119 changes no code in either crate. Evidence: unchanged-sync package-CI run 43588305714, macOS job 132427519558.
A maintainer (sync-2143) is working on this (seatbelt exclusion ordering + exec-server codex_home_symlink on macos-15); PR to the sync branch to follow.

Fixed by #2385 (merged into the sync branch as 68c3b767e5).
- Seatbelt ordering: the runner's TMPDIR is `/var/folders/...`, so the cwd was spelled `/var/...` while its writable root resolved to `/private/var/...`; a default `.codex` carve-out then escaped the spelling check and stayed ahead of the explicit `.git/.agents/.codex/.aws` ones. Reproducible on any Mac with `TMPDIR=$(getconf DARWIN_USER_TEMP_DIR)`. The fix in `protocol/src/permissions.rs` lets a duplicate default take its explicit entry's place; the set of carve-outs is unchanged (no exclusion dropped). New macOS test `writable_root_carveouts_do_not_depend_on_the_cwd_spelling`. Both seatbelt tests pass on macos-15 (scratch package CI run 43811967455).
- `codex_home_symlink_opt_out_respects_host_config_and_scope` (failed on every Mac, not only the runner): it asserted upstream's symlinked-writable-root refusal, which Corbanu does not take (S3a ledger row for sandboxing/src/seatbelt.rs). Renamed `codex_home_symlink_roots_write_at_their_real_location`; now asserts main's behaviour, as `exec/tests/suite/seatbelt.rs` does.
Follow-up noted by the reviewer (not in this PR; core tests don't compile yet): `core/tests/suite/agents_md.rs` `symlinked_writable_root_reports_sandbox_failure_instead_of_session_corruption` still asserts upstream's refusal and will need the same adaptation once codex-core tests build.

title: upstream sync: macOS-runner failures in codex-sandboxing seatbelt ordering and exec-server codex_home_symlink tests (sync branch)
